board.control_bus_notes: Stock XQ1 1.21 table843054 and XQ2 1.01 table8435a4 each contain these nine address/polarity/channel rows. This includes bus1 charge target0a; physical chip identities remain unmeasured.

gpio.profile_name: Declared released S1/S2 at GPIO0.2/3=1 from stock XQ key input table; remaining borrowed acquisition inputs unmeasured.

power.profile_name: Declared XQ normal MCU status0x43 (POWER and PLAY released); SPI1 CS12.3 with panel CS12.1 inactive, from XQ1 table0x840600 and native GPIO writes. Selector ADC8=0 releases the flag10 ladder below101; rear-key ADC9=1023 releases the flag40 ladder. Zoom lever ADC4=1023 released; remaining ADC and MCU packet borrowed. MCU R60 is an external status input; writes are unmeasured commands, not button loopback.

storage_slots.basis: XQ1 and XQ2 specifications: one SD card slot (UHS-I).
